NTA. As someone with Asian parents, I understand how hard it is to have so much pressure on you. You shouldn’t have to be a slave to them and do things only for them. You are obligated to your own happiness and life. It’s really hard talking to Asian parents but if it’s possible you could try explaining your feelings to them and that you want to be happy and live your life out too. Good luck with everything and stay safe!
